biggest_catch: Credit offsets your bills only - it is never paid out as cash, cannot be refunded, and if you add a second supply (e.g., gas after electricity) after the reward is calculated, that extra supply earns nothing.
catches: The referred customer must be supplied by Fuse Energy with at least one eligible supply (import electricity or gas); export-only supplies do not count.
The credit is a flat £100 per referred customer regardless of whether they take one or both supplies.
The credit is applied as an offset against subsequent bills only - not available for refund or redeemable for cash.
Fuse Energy reserves the right to cancel or amend the campaign without notice, and only one promotional reward credit per customer where multiple apply.

steps: As an existing Fuse Energy customer, share your referral with a friend or family member.
Your referral signs up with Fuse Energy for import electricity and/or gas.
Once Fuse Energy supplies them, £100 credit is applied to each of your accounts.
The credit offsets your subsequent bills until fully used.
